items.prompt: 围绕灵活办公写一个理由段：先提出好处，再用 however 补充限制。
items.starter: Flexible working arrangements can help employees manage their time more effectively.
items.reference: Flexible working arrangements can help employees manage their time more effectively. For example, they may spend less time travelling and more time with their families. However, employers still need clear rules so that communication does not suffer.
checklist: 首句是否表达中心意思
例子是否支持中心意思
转折后是否给出真实限制

items.prompt: 说明职业培训为什么重要：写出观点、原因和一个结果。
items.starter: Training remains important even for experienced workers.
items.reference: Training remains important even for experienced workers because industries continue to change. New skills give employees access to different tasks and opportunities. As a result, they are better prepared when their jobs change.
checklist: 结果是否由前面的原因推出
